name: x2611_15723_cycleShuffle_card
statement:
(k l : ℕ) (σ : Equiv.Perm (Fin k)) (τ : Equiv.Perm (Fin l))
    (h : x2611_15723_noOrderIso σ τ) :
  (x2611_15723_cycleShuffle σ τ).card = Nat.choose (k + l) k
closed:
∀ (k l : ℕ) (σ : Equiv.Perm (Fin k)) (τ : Equiv.Perm (Fin l))
    (h : x2611_15723_noOrderIso σ τ), (x2611_15723_cycleShuffle σ τ).card = Nat.choose (k + l) k
informal: Section 1.1, cardinality with no order-isomorphic cycles
original: We first investigate the case when no cycle of $\sigma$ is order-isomorphic to a cycle of $\tau$ ; we say that $\sigma$ and $\tau$ have no order-isomorphic cycles. In this case, we have $|\sigma\shuffle_{c}\tau|=\binom{n}{k}$ , since $\pi\in\sigma\shuffle_{c}\tau$ is uniquely determined by the partition $[n]=K\sqcup L$ .
type: ∀ (k l : ℕ) (σ : Equiv.Perm (Fin k)) (τ : Equiv.Perm (Fin l)), Mathlib2.x2611_15723_noOrderIso σ τ → (Mathlib2.x2611_15723_cycleShuffle σ τ).card = (k + l).choose k
